items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026
items.q: musicians that said publicly who we helped so I can say Roberta Flack, Sinead O’Connor

ctx.x: You must really sleep well at night, Wendy, and I’d like to wrap this up with an observation and then a quote. Usually when I research for an interview and I look up a musician’s information there’ll be lists of, let’s say Milt Hinton, you know and they’ll list all the records he played on and all this. And a discography so to speak. Well you have your own discography with the recognitions and the awards that you have received, and I’m extremely impressed by what you’ve done. I never thought I would be quoting an…

Thank you, thank you for doing this, and for all the archives I’ve been watching and they’ve been incredible. You get moments of people where you don’t usually see who they are. And I just did want to say that for anyone watching who has money to donate, please give to the Jazz Foundation of America. You know every time a musician calls me and something is happening, they’ll pay their rent. People that, I mean oh my goodness you know we never say who we help because there are pride issues but there are musicians…
All right. Thank you so much.
